data.name: Foresight Fellowship

data.name: GovAI Fellowship
data.description: Governance program run by the Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI), aimed at early-career individuals and established professionals new to AI governance. Participants pursue a research or applied project under expert mentorship and build field connections.

data.name: Talos Fellowship
data.description: Launches and accelerates European AI policy careers focused on the safe and responsible deployment of advanced AI. Combines an 8-week online reading group with a week-long policymaking summit in Brussels, plus optional tracks including a paid placement.

data.name: ARENA (Alignment Research Engineer Accelerator)
data.description: Trains aspiring alignment researchers and engineers in ML through an intensive curriculum. Participants work through programming exercises in pairs under the guidance of expert teaching assistants.

data.name: Global Challenges Project (GCP)
data.description: Intensive residential workshop run by Kairos, exploring the foundational arguments around risks from advanced AI and biotechnology. Includes guest speakers, career planning, and 1-on-1s.

data.name: ERA:AI Fellowship
data.description: Research program for researchers and entrepreneurs mitigating risks from frontier AI. Fellows pursue a mentored project in technical AI safety, AI governance, or technical AI governance.

data.name: LASR Labs
data.description: Research program focused on reducing the risk of loss of control to advanced AI, tackling action-relevant questions on concrete threat models. Participants work in teams of 3–4 with an experienced supervisor to write an academic-style paper.

data.name: Pivotal Research Fellowship
data.description: Program for projects spanning technical AI safety, governance, and AI-bio. Includes mentorship, research management, workshops, and workspace at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA). Provides continued funding of up to six months for strong work.

data.name: Pathfinder Fellowship
data.description: Supports students around the world who are organizing technical AI safety or AI policy university groups. Participants receive mentorship, funding, and other resources to develop into on-campus leaders, preparing themselves and their group members for careers in the field.

data.name: AI Governance Taskforce
data.description: Helps experienced professionals transition into AI governance careers. Small teams tackle policy-relevant research with expert partners like the UK AI Security Institute (AISI) and GovAI, typically producing a paper and a policy brief or article.

data.name: Algoverse AI Safety
data.description: Immerses participants in safety research through expert-led sessions and hands-on projects. Teams of three survey research agendas, build technical skills, and work with mentors to produce a paper for conference submission.

data.description: Intensive run by the Oxford AI Safety Initiative (OAISI) designed to rapidly build AI safety skills – covering interpretability, RLHF, and replicating alignment research papers. Expects basic familiarity with linear algebra, Python, and AI safety.

data.name: CAMBRIA

data.name: CBAI Research Fellowship
data.description: Research program run by the Cambridge Boston Alignment Initiative (CBAI). Fellows work closely with mentors on projects across interpretability, formal verification, and AI governance.

data.name: MARS (Mentorship for Alignment Research Students)

data.name: Cooperative AI Summer School

data.name: XLab Summer Research Fellowship

data.name: Dilemmas and Dangers in AI
data.description: Run by Leaf for students aged 14–19 who haven't yet started university, exploring how to steer AI toward benefiting humanity. Includes discussion groups, talks and Q&As with AI safety researchers, and mentorship.

data.description: Participants work as research associates on projects supervised by experienced leads. Topics span AI policy, technical safety, and AI sentience. Provides research experience and helps build professional networks.

data.name: HIP Impact Accelerator Program (IAP)
data.description: Program run by High Impact Professionals (HIP) helping experienced mid-career and senior professionals transition into high-impact careers – including AI safety. Participants follow a guided workbook, attend weekly group sessions, and receive continued support after the program.

data.name: IAPS AI Policy Fellowship
data.description: Strengthens practical policy skills for a world with powerful AI. Professionals from varied backgrounds pursue independent projects with expert mentorship, joining in Washington D.C. or remotely after an in-person residency.

data.name: Athena Mentorship Program

data.name: AI Security Bootcamp (AISB)
data.description: Equips experienced security professionals to secure frontier AI systems. Covers adversarial ML, LLM security, and AI infrastructure through demos and hands-on red/blue team exercises.

data.name: PIBBSS Fellowship
data.description: Interdisciplinary research program connecting PhD and postdoctoral researchers from fields like mathematics, neuroscience, physics, and philosophy with AI safety mentors. Projects bridge the participant's field and AI safety.
